tarjetas.detalle: Each group's interests, power and interest
Communicate early and honestly; listen first

turnos.t: How can managers reduce stakeholder conflict?

Identify the stakeholders and their interests. Map their power and interest. Communicate and consult early and honestly, listening before deciding. Negotiate a compromise, like delaying a closure or paying compensation. Then monitor and adjust.
Then managers must decide whose interests come first, and explain why. Linking the choice to the mission and objectives makes it much easier to justify to stakeholders.
